CJP activists protest against CEC in Mumbai, demand resignation

In Mumbai, activists from Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) and youth groups held a protest at Shivaji Park, demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Dnyanesh Kumar. Protesters used unique posters and questioned Kumar's stance on democracy. Actor Javed Akhtar was also present and spoke at the event. The protest was organized in response to recent actions and statements by the Election Commission.
